title: Anvil
description: &3Anvils&r are a tiered crafting station that allows for the creation of various machines, structures, and items in some cases. There are multiple tiers of anvils with greater anvil tier primarily corresponding to a greater quantity of recipes being available.
Plate Stamps, used in the &3Burner Press&r, are made in the anvil. A plate stamp is required for the &3Blast Furnace&r.
